description: List a page of campaigns for the organisation. Use when the user asks "what campaigns do I have?" or "show my active campaigns". Returns each campaign brief and status; use get_campaign for linked audience details. Pass the returned next_cursor as cursor to fetch another page. Requires 'discovery' scope.

compact.description: Return small name/status summaries by default; set false for each saved brief and timestamps. Call get_campaign for linked audiences.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous list_campaigns page

name: list_campaigns

count_state.description: Unknown means no count; available does not guarantee freshness. Recount for a current value.

guidance.description: Interpretation or recovery guidance for this result

next_actions.description: Suggested next calls using returned IDs and available scopes. Not executed and not user consent.

page_count.description: Number of objects on this page, not the organization total

population_input.description: Population input used for the preview; IDs refer to their current saved definitions
